## This part is being written
It will go online soon. Until then, see the [lesson overview](index.qmd), or the [current 16S page](https://methods-in-microbiomics.readthedocs.io/en/latest/taxonomic_profiling/16S.html) on the old site.

## What this part will cover

- The 16S gene, its nine variable regions, and why 18S and ITS are used for eukaryotes and fungi.
- What influences the outcome of a 16S study, from sampling to the reference database.
- The lab's primer table (V1–V3, V3–V4, V4, V4–V5), and why no primer pair is universal.
- 16S copy number: why the share of reads isn't the share of cells, tried out on a mock community.
- Relative vs absolute abundance, and how to measure the latter.
